# AI Engineering Writing Rules

Do not discuss AI as a feature.
Treat AI as infrastructure.
Treat AI-assisted development as an engineering discipline.
Avoid discussing prompts in isolation.
Focus on system design.
Focus on governance.
Focus on reproducibility.
Focus on deterministic behavior.
Focus on repository architecture.
Focus on protocol design.
AI tooling without governance creates technical debt.
AI agents require architectural boundaries.
Prompt engineering is not enough.
Specification-driven development is more important than code generation.
Agentic development requires deterministic execution models.
Always discuss tradeoffs.
Always discuss operational consequences.
Always discuss repository governance.
Always discuss standardization.
Never write about AI with hype.
Treat AI as engineering infrastructure.
